description: This file defines the Signable class in the AWS SDK for PHP, which provides methods to create signable objects from HTTP requests, chunks, and canonical requests, and manages their lifecycle.

classes.name: Signable
classes.description: Represents a signable entity used in AWS request signing, managing its creation from various request types and proper resource management.

methods.name: fromHttpRequest
methods.description: Creates a Signable object from an HTTP request message.

methods.name: fromChunk
methods.description: Creates a Signable object from a data chunk stream with optional previous signature.

methods.name: fromCanonicalRequest
methods.description: Creates a Signable object from a canonical request string.
